entities.name: Moonfolk
entities.description: Enigmatic flying humanoid race of Kamigawa dwelling in the clouds, claiming descent from a moon Myojin.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane native to the moonfolk.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: Flying city of the moonfolk, later opened to other races and made the plane's center of learning and innovation.

entities.name: Oboro
entities.description: Moonfolk palace not opened to outsiders.

entities.name: Mochi
entities.description: Worked secretly with the soratami during the Kami War era.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Manipulated into inciting a war between mortals and kami.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War between mortals and kami on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Saiba Futurists
entities.description: Group of innovators established by the moonfolk, mostly soratami.

entities.name: Kairi
entities.description: Dragon kami who refused the moonfolk's request to protect Otawara.

events.summary: During the Kami War era, Mochi and the soratami secretly plot to make the soratami dominant by manipulating Konda into inciting war between mortals and kami; the effort fails.
events.quote: However, these efforts would ultimately fail.

events.summary: In Kamigawa's Modern Age the moonfolk open Otawara to outsiders and it becomes a center of innovation.
events.quote: opening Otawara to outsiders (though still not Oboro palace itself), and allowing the city to become a center of innovation

events.summary: The moonfolk establish the Saiba Futurists and ask the dragon kami Kairi to protect Otawara, but Kairi refuses.
events.quote: the moonfolk asked the dragon kami Kairi to protect their city, only for the great kami to refuse

relations.note: worked secretly together in the Kami War era
relations.quote: Mochi and the soratami secretly worked together

relations.note: established them and make up the majority
relations.quote: The Soratami still make up a majority of the Saiba Futurists
particularly in the flying city of Otawara
